rubric: A feature across a few files of one area: medium risk.

criteria.level: An ordinary feature or fix across a few files in one area

reading.why: A feature across a few files of one area: medium risk.

ruledOut.question: level
ruledOut.label: low
ruledOut.why: A feature across a few files of one area: medium risk. It is not low: docs, tests, copy, styling or a small change in one place with no data, auth, money or shared contract near it.

ruledOut.question: level
ruledOut.label: high
ruledOut.why: A feature across a few files of one area: medium risk. It is not high: auth, payments, secrets, migrations, infrastructure, a public contract, or a large change across many areas.
